hings I wish I knew before buying my first pump:

Comfort matters just as much as suction. A powerful pump is great, but if it's uncomfortable or doesn't fit your lifestyle, you're much less likely to enjoy using it.

Think about how you'll actually use your pump every day. I needed to be able to hold my baby, work, or do things around the house while pumping. Being hands-free became my top priority.

Don't be afraid to switch if something isn't working. Just because a pump is highly recommended doesn't mean it's the best pump for you.
